0022600202.text: The Miami Heat (3-5, on a one-game winning streak) visit the Sacramento Kings (1-7, having lost their last game), with Miami sitting 9th in the East and 1.5 games back in the Southeast. The Kings are without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and the Heat won their last meeting 130-117 in Sacramento on January 20, 2026.
